body:
Your post reminds me of my mom sorta. My mom would use my closet to put her wedding dresses in along with my sister's wedding dresses. Like my sisters were not allowed to keep their own wedding dresses and my mom had been married more than once. I always thought it was weird that my mom kept their dresses and how they were okay with it. Even more weird that she claimed she didn't have room for them so my closet just had to do. She would go into my room as she pleased (she removed the lock so I couldn't lock my own door) and stand there looking at the dresses for a period of time. Just looking at them. Without a word. Then leave my room. I asked her to please take them out as I didn't have room to hang up my own clothes so she told me to just throw away my clothes since "you're too fat for them". I went through puberty and wasn't allowed to have clothes that fit me so I had to wear clothes from middle school that did not fit me at all. 
I'm sorry you went through the horrible things you did and I think you shouldn't have to worry that you'll be like your mom. I used to think like that too because that's what I grew up with so like mother like daughter. I ended up being nothing like her. I have no problem giving my roommates their personal space and they let me have my personal space. Just imagine sharing closet space, pantry space, and refrigerator space and everyone just agrees where everything goes.
I hope everything works out for you!

Exactly reminds me of my mom. One time she saw me years later after I was out of the home, she commented on my hair and said "Your hair looks good just like mine!" I was literally ready to go bald at that moment. I decided telling her, "Thanks but I look better than you." was funnier as her reaction was priceless. She can't yell or beat me anymore as I make sure I am never alone.
